three truths

The Roast & The Toast

tap each card. tell me I'm wrong.

the roast

you have the patience of a toddler and the grudges of an elephant.

the toast

but you remember exactly how everyone around you takes their tea. that's not anger, Sugar — that's love wearing a disguise.

the roast

you can turn "I'm fine" into a full-length war documentary.

the toast

and you're still the first one showing up with food when someone's actually having a bad day. here's to people finally deserving you.

the roast

you argue like you're being paid by the word.

the toast

but every fight ends because you cared enough to have it — never because you stopped caring. here's to a year kinder to your fire.

for real though

My Sugar,

there's no card loud enough for everything I want to say, so I built you this instead — chaos, roasts, and all.

thank you for loving hard even when you're mid-rant. I used to think the temper and the tenderness were two different people. now I know they're the same one — you just care loud enough that it sometimes sounds like anger.

I hope this year gives you fewer reasons to be mad and a hundred more to laugh the way you do when you forget to be tough.

happy birthday to my favorite kind of trouble. I love every version of you — especially the one currently rolling her eyes at this.

yours, always — Apex
